Received this feedback from Bart Preneel:

> Consider adding: AEGIS (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-irtf-cfrg-aegis-aead/) as it is substantially faster than all other modes.

References:

* [AEGIS: A Fast Authenticated Encryption Algorithm (v1.1)](https://competitions.cr.yp.to/round3/aegisv11.pdf)
* [The AEGIS Family of Authenticated Encryption Algorithms ](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-irtf-cfrg-aegis-aead/)
* [AEGIS: A Fast Authenticated Encryption Algorithm (Full Version)](https://eprint.iacr.org/2013/695.pdf)
* 
Note that Bart Preneel is one of the designers of AEGIS.
